newsitem.title: USA: Int'l Technology sets reverse stock split.
newsitem.headline: Int'l Technology sets reverse stock split.

text.p: International Technology Corp said Wednesday its stockholders have approved one-for-four reverse split.

The reverse stock split will be effective for trading on Thursday and will cut the number of common shares outstanding to about 9 million from about 36 million. The company said in a statement it believes that the reverse split will enhance the liquidity and marketability of the company's stock.
The company also announced that The Carlyle Group has completed a $45 million investment in a newly issued preferred stock of the company.
